en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a tall, ornate stone observation tower rising above surrounding trees. The tower has small windows along its shaft and a decorative upper section with round windows and battlement-like elements. At the base is an arched entrance reached by a short staircase, with detailed masonry and an inscribed plaque above the doorway. Printed title text appears in the upper left corner.
